item.title: Jeep Wrangler Willys 41 special edition returns at lower price for MY2026
item.description: Jeep has brought back the Wrangler Willys 41 Special Edition in India for the 2026 model year at Rs 70.31 lakh. Limited to 41 units, the SUV gets heritage-inspired design elements, added accessories and the same 2.0-litre turbo-petrol engine with 4×4 as standard.

item.title: Vijay–Rashmika wedding: PM Narendra Modi sends heartfelt message ahead of big day
item.description: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s Udaipur wedding received a special boost after Prime Minister Narendra Modi responded to their invitation. Calling it a “beautiful new chapter,” his message has gone viral. Here’s what he wrote and other key wedding details.

item.title: Leopard spotted near Ghaziabad school, campus shut as search operation begins
item.description: A leopard was spotted near Greenfield Public School in Govindpuram, Ghaziabad, triggering panic in the area. Authorities immediately shut the school and barricaded nearby roads. Forest Department teams have launched a search operation, while police have increased security and urged residents to stay indoors and avoid rumours.

item.title: Uttarakhand: Man beaten while offering namaz near temple, Muslim community demands strict police action
item.description: In Rudrapur, a man offering namaz near Ataria temple was beaten with sticks. The incident’s video went viral, sparking outrage in the Muslim community, which demanded police action against the accused.

item.title: Beauty-from-within 2.0: How peptides are transforming India’s hair market
item.description: Peptides are short chains of amino acids, the core building blocks of proteins like keratin, collagen, and elastin. However, their role goes beyond supplying raw materials. Unlike traditional vitamins, peptides act as signaling molecules within the body. In practical terms, they send messages to cells.

item.title: Axar or Sundar – Why not both? Ravi Shastri wants India to play duo in must-win clash vs Zimbabwe
item.description: Former India head coach Ravi Shastri has advised India to consider including both Washington Sundar and Axar Patel in their playing XI for their must-win Super Eight clash against Zimbabwe in the T20 World Cup 2026.

item.title: Check this AI stock: It can surge as much as 98%, says broking major CLSA
item.description: After the meltdown in information technology socks that AI scare has triggered, it seems to be just a matter of time before investor attention turns towards AI firms. AI-based IT company Coforge seems to be already attracting focus with global brokerage CLSA assigning a target price showing 88% upside potential.

item.title: Pak judge serves Islamabad High Court with forged law degree for 5 years. Here’s how he did it
item.description: A shocking fraud at the Islamabad High Court (IHC) has been revealed: a judge served for years with a fake law degree. His appointment has been declared void *ab initio* due to forged educational papers, including impersonation. The IHC bench removed him, invalidating his past verdicts and raising serious questions about judicial integrity and the legal implications of such a monumental deception.

item.title: India’s AI boom faces revenue test as OpenAI, Google end free offers
item.description: India became the world’s largest generative AI download market in 2025, with installs jumping 207 percent year-over-year. However, despite driving nearly 20 percent of global downloads, the country accounts for just 1% of in-app revenue, highlighting a major monetization gap.

item.title: Why is arthritis emerging as a disease of the young in India?
item.description: There has been a noticeable rise in individuals between 25 and 45 years presenting with early arthritis, particularly affecting the knee and hip joints. Sedentary habits, poor muscle conditioning, post-traumatic joint injuries, metabolic factors, and autoimmune conditions are contributing significantly to this growing trend.
